caption: The drawing features a cylindrical tankard with a large curved handle and a hinged lid. The tankard is depicted in grayscale with precise shading to indicate its metallic surface and reflective qualities. The handle is ornate with a curled lower section and a decorative thumb lift attached to the hinge of the lid. The lid is domed and fits snugly over the opening of the tankard. At the top left of the drawing, there is an inset diagram showing the side elevation of the tankard with detailed measurements labeled in inches, displaying the proportions and structural features. In the top right area of the main drawing, there is a small arc, possibly illustrating a detail of the lid’s edge. The drawing is framed by a thin rectangular border and is presented on a light-colored, slightly yellowed background, giving an impression of aged paper.
title: Silver Tankard
